# `k.ui`

Import each declaration by name, for example `import k.ui.AriaRole`.

| Declaration | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`AriaRole`](#ariarole) | The roles `.role(...)` accepts: only roles no semantic element expresses (`docs/design/05-views.md`, "Attributes are per element"). |
| [`Axis`](#axis) | A layout direction, such as [`Stack.axis`](#stack). |
| [`ButtonType`](#buttontype) | The `.type(...)` attribute of `button` (`docs/design/05-views.md`). |
| [`ElementSize`](#elementsize) | The size of an element's content box, the payload of the `resized` event every element has (`docs/design/45-web-platform.md`, "Element events"). |
| [`ErrorBoundary`](#errorboundary) | Catches panics in its content and renders `fallback` instead (`docs/design/09-errors.md`, "Panics"). |
| [`Grid`](#grid) | Lays out its content in a grid of equal columns. |
| [`Icon`](#icon) | An icon from the bundled icon set. |
| [`IconName`](#iconname) | The icons of the bundled set. |
| [`ImageLoading`](#imageloading) | The `.loading(...)` attribute of `image`. |
| [`KeyboardShortcut`](#keyboardshortcut) | A single-key keyboard shortcut for the page while the component is mounted (`docs/design/43-keyboard-shortcuts.md`): pressing `key` fires `pressed`, unless the user is typing in a field or holds Control, Alt or Meta. |
| [`Locale`](#locale) | A locale for formatting numbers, dates and money, set with `locale(...)` in `metadata` ([`MetadataEntries.locale`](#metadataentries), `docs/design/22-metadata.md`). |
| [`MetadataEntries`](#metadataentries) | The entries of a `metadata { }` block (`docs/design/22-metadata.md`). |
| [`Router`](#router) | Client-side navigation (`docs/design/12-routing.md`, "Navigation"). |
| [`Spacer`](#spacer) | Takes up the free space in a [`Stack`](#stack). |
| [`Stack`](#stack) | Lays out its content in a row or a column with a gap. |
| [`StructuredData`](#structureddata) | A schema.org entry for `structuredData(...)` in `metadata` ([`MetadataEntries.structuredData`](#metadataentries)). |
| [`Theme`](#theme) | The app's active theme variant (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`, "Switching variants at runtime"). |
| [`VisuallyHidden`](#visuallyhidden) | Content that screen readers announce but that isn't shown, for adding words to an accessible name (`docs/design/05-views.md`): `button { "Delete"  VisuallyHidden { " {todo.title}" } }`. |

## AriaRole

```k,ignore
public enum AriaRole
```

The roles `.role(...)` accepts: only roles no semantic element expresses
(`docs/design/05-views.md`, "Attributes are per element").

**Members**

- `case alert`
  An important, time-sensitive message (a live region).
- `case status`
  An advisory status message (a live region).
- `case group`
  A group of related controls.
- `case toolbar`
  A toolbar: a row of controls.
- `case region`
  A region of the page; use `section` when it has a heading.
- `case navigation`
  A navigation landmark; always a compile error, with the hint "use
  `nav`".

## Axis

```k,ignore
public enum Axis
```

A layout direction, such as [`Stack.axis`](#stack).

**Members**

- `case horizontal`
  Left to right (in left-to-right languages).
- `case vertical`
  Top to bottom.

## ButtonType

```k,ignore
public enum ButtonType
```

The `.type(...)` attribute of `button` (`docs/design/05-views.md`).

**Members**

- `case submit`
  Submits the enclosing form. The default inside a `form`.
- `case button`
  Does nothing by itself; needed on a non-submitting button in a form.
- `case reset`
  Resets the enclosing form.

## KeyboardShortcut

```k,ignore
public component KeyboardShortcut
```

A single-key keyboard shortcut for the page while the component is
mounted (`docs/design/43-keyboard-shortcuts.md`): pressing `key` fires
`pressed`, unless the user is typing in a field or holds Control, Alt
or Meta. It renders nothing, so the control that does the same thing
should show the key, and the page should list its shortcuts.

## MetadataEntries

```k,ignore
public class MetadataEntries
```

The entries of a `metadata { }` block (`docs/design/22-metadata.md`).

A metadata block's body is checked with an implicit receiver of this
type, so `title("…")` resolves to `MetadataEntries.title`. Which entries
are allowed where (`status` only inside `failed`, `manifest`, `themeColor`
and `locale` only in `App.k`) is checked by the compiler.

**Members**

- `func title(_ text: String)`
  Sets the document title.
- `func description(_ text: String)`
  Sets the description; over 160 characters is a warning.
- `func canonical(_ page: Page)`
  Sets the canonical URL to `page`'s, rendered absolute.
- `func socialPreview(image: Url, title: String)`
  Sets the Open Graph (and similar) preview shown when the page is
  shared.

  - Parameters:
    - image: the preview image.
    - title: the preview title.
- `func structuredData(_ data: StructuredData)`
  Adds a schema.org entry ([`StructuredData`](#structureddata)).
- `func icon(_ url: Url)`
  Sets the page icon.
- `func manifest(name: String, shortName: String)`
  Sets the web manifest; `App.k` only.

  - Parameters:
    - name: the app's full name.
    - shortName: the name under the home-screen icon.
- `func themeColor(_ color: Color)`
  Sets the browser theme color; `App.k` only.
- `func locale(_ locale: Locale)`
  Sets the locale for formatting ([`Locale`](#locale)); `App.k` only.
- `func status(_ status: HttpStatus)`
  Sets the HTTP status of a server-rendered `failed` page
  ([`k.http.HttpStatus`](k-http.md#httpstatus)); only in a `metadata` block inside `failed`.

## Router

```k,ignore
public class Router
```

Client-side navigation (`docs/design/12-routing.md`, "Navigation").

**Members**

- `static func navigate(to page: Page)`

## Theme

```k,ignore
@ClientOnly
public service Theme
```

The app's active theme variant (`docs/design/07-themes-and-units.md`,
"Switching variants at runtime"). Client-only; inject it with
`@Inject let theme: Theme`.

**Members**

- `var current: ThemeVariant`
  The active variant ([`k.core.ThemeVariant`](k-core.md#themevariant)). Reactive.
- `func apply(_ variant: ThemeVariant)`
  Makes `variant` active by swapping one class on the document root,
  and remembers the choice in the `k_theme` cookie.
- `func followSystem()`
  Forgets the explicit choice, so variants that `match` a system
  preference apply again.
